description: NOBIL is the public database of electric vehicle charging stations for Norway and Sweden, with an open API. Contents: per the OpenStreetMap wiki, station locations with charger details such as connector type, number of connectors and charging capacity, collected from EV users, station owners and operators; the wiki counted 8,527 stations across the Nordic countries in March 2023 (4,089 in September 2018), and NOBIL's site says it now supports real-time availability status of charging points. Producer: developed and maintained by the Norwegian Electric Vehicle Association, financed and owned by Enova, an agency under Norway's climate ministry; Swedish stations are maintained by the Swedish Energy Agency. Coverage: Norway and Sweden; from October 2025 the API no longer includes Denmark, Finland or Iceland. Licence (read on 2026-09-29): CC-BY-4.0 (NOBIL by Enova; API key required). Caveats: charger coordinates sometimes point to a whole car park, not the exact charger. Simulation uses: siting and load of EV charging in grid impact, transport electrification and evacuation models. Related records: none identified.
